mainEntity.name: How do I share a link to a verse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press the verse number and choose Copy link. The link opens the web app on that verse, for anyone.

mainEntity.name: How do I copy a passage with its reference?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press the verse number (Shift-press another for a run) and choose Copy. The verses are copied numbered, with the reference under them.

mainEntity.name: How do I make an image of a verse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Type "card" and a passage in the palette, for example "card ps 23:1-3". The card studio opens with templates, colours, type and sizes, and copies or saves the image.

mainEntity.name: How do I export a passage with my notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Type "export" and a passage in the palette: Markdown, a citation, plain text, a file or a sheet to print.
